valueType.description: Required. Type of the parameter: string, int, bool etc.

id.description: Required. ID of the config variable. Must be unique within the configuration.

enumOptions.description: Optional. Enum options. To be populated if `ValueType` is `ENUM`.

validationRegex.description: Optional. Regular expression in RE2 syntax used for validating the `value` of a `ConfigVariable`.

description.description: Optional. Description.

required.description: Optional. Flag represents that this `ConfigVariable` must be provided for a PluginInstance.

multiSelectOptions.description: Optional. Multi select options. To be populated if `ValueType` is `MULTI_SELECT`.

GoogleCloudApihubV1ConfigVariableTemplat.description: ConfigVariableTemplate represents a configuration variable template present in a Plugin Config.

description.description: Optional. Description of the option.

displayName.description: Required. Display name of the option.

GoogleCloudApihubV1ConfigValueOption.description: ConfigValueOption represents an option for a config variable of type enum or multi select.

config.description: Required. The config of the addon to be managed. This config will replace the config present in the addon. The type of the config should match the config type already present in the addon.

multiSelectValues.description: Optional. The config variable value in case of config variable of type multi select.

boolValue.description: Optional. The config variable value in case of config variable of type boolean.

multiIntValues.description: Optional. The config variable value in case of config variable of type multi integer.

enumValue.description: Optional. The config variable value in case of config variable of type enum.

multiStringValues.description: Optional. The config variable value in case of config variable of type multi string.

key.description: Output only. Key will be the id to uniquely identify the config variable.

intValue.description: Optional. The config variable value in case of config variable of type integer.

secretValue.description: Optional. The config variable value in case of config variable of type secret.

stringValue.description: Optional. The config variable value in case of config variable of type string.

GoogleCloudApihubV1ConfigVariable.description: ConfigVariable represents a additional configuration variable present in a PluginInstance Config or AuthConfig, based on a ConfigVariableTemplate.

externalApis.description: The External API resources present in the API hub.

nextPageToken.description: A token, which can be sent as `page_token` to retrieve the next page. If this field is omitted, there are no subsequent pages.
